facts.text: Named to SUNY Canton's President's List for the Fall 2025 semester as an Individual Studies student, Jan 2026
Named to SUNY Canton's President's List for the Spring 2022 semester as a Criminal Investigation major
Named to SUNY Canton's President's List for the Fall 2022 semester as a Criminal Investigation major
Received the Carbary Scholarship at SUNY Potsdam's School of Education & Professional Studies Honors Convocation on May 7, 2024
Received the Elizabeth 'Betsy' Burgan Northrop Class of 1961 Scholarship at SUNY Potsdam's School of Education & Professional Studies Honors Convocation on May 7, 2024
Scored the eventual game-winner as a SUNY Potsdam senior captain in a 12-9 win at St. Joseph's College of Long Island, Mar 12, 2017
Placed ninth in the men's javelin for St. Lawrence at the NYSCTC Outdoor Track & Field Championships in Rochester, May 4-5, 2012, with a mark of 143' 9"

At Potsdam High School, Miller-Lynch was a three-time All-Northern football selection, a team captain and Section X Sportsmanship Award winner, and a two-time Section X indoor track champion and NYSPHSAA State Championships qualifier who also captained the track team
Named a DAISY Award honoree at Canton-Potsdam Hospital, recognized in a patient's nomination for exceptional compassionate care during a difficult delivery and hospital stay

note: AM run. Checked 75 people and filed 9 bullets across 7 people, each verified on its source page by the parent and read back in the Sheet exactly once. Fresh sweep: nothing new to file. Items published Oct 23 to Nov 13 across NCPR, North Country Now, NNY360, WWNY and ClickNNY, the four colleges' news and athletics, honors announcements and health-system news named directory members only in already-filed items (Janelle Evans's and Isa Goettl's Nov 7 Union game is already on their records) or known-role mentions (Zvi Szafran's scholarship-drive commendation, logged not filed on Nov 9 and again here); the sweep's other names (Andrew Beck, Terry Goodrich, Mike Toshack, Alma Ameigeiras) are not in the directory. Filed: Jocelyn Daniels's President's List for Fall 2025, named exactly (her record said only 'academic honors list'); Leslie Perri's President's Lists for Spring 2022 and Fall 2022; Mallory Greene's Carbary Scholarship and Northrop Class of 1961 Scholarship (both SUNY Potsdam Honors Convocation, May 7, 2024); Katie Lapinski's game-winning goal at St. Joseph's (Mar 12, 2017 — the same story's assist total is not filed because the page says both five and four); Jon Cyphers's ninth-place NYSCTC javelin finish (May 2012); Liam Miller-Lynch's Potsdam High School bio honors from his St. Lawrence roster page; and Ramsey Clary Thomas's DAISY Award at Canton-Potsdam Hospital (filed without the patient's details). CORRECTION FLAG: Mallory Greene's record also credits her with the Eola Pitz Memorial Scholarship from that same May 7, 2024 convocation. The convocation program itself lists Tiara Palazzo-Cross as the Eola Pitz recipient — Greene's name sits right before the Eola Pitz heading, as the Northrop recipient. The two correct scholarships are filed above; the Eola Pitz bullet was left in place for your call. Not filed: batch claims for Jenna Moulton (Hall of Fame, clubfeet interest, society memberships), Natalie Waterman (2023 EMS Youth Provider of the Year, January 2025 Life paper) and Mark C Walczyk's re-election were all already on file in the Sheet and were discarded; Jon Cyphers's EP and single releases were likewise already on file. 4 candidates added to the Research Command ledger (identity holds for Jale and Nevaeh Phillips; a sensitive hold for Libby Criscitello; a verification record for Katie Lapinski's assist total, which SUNY Potsdam's own page states two ways). 8 of JD's console filings (made Nov 12) were reconciled into changes.json.
